claim: One semantic artifact can be assembled from multiple exact byte objects without collapsing their byte identities, and can later project into runtime, print, hardware and evidence views through explicit relations.

semantic_contract.return: Successful RUN emits command, transform values, applied projection, elapsed time and trial result.
semantic_contract.bridge: AXIAL_PACKET can drive the same core experiment through page API, postMessage or BroadcastChannel without changing semantic grammar.

round_trip.from: Library source names → staged bytes → inventory hashes → semantic lineage object
round_trip.return: Exact component names + hashes remain sufficient to return to byte-level identity; semantic relations can be dropped without changing source bytes.

return_receipt.before: Runnable HTML, README, print template and build notes existed as separate files with no common ingest object.
return_receipt.after: The HTML and README are one explicit semantic artifact composed of two exact byte objects; print/build materials remain related siblings; current AXIAL head remains a later unequal projection.
return_receipt.delta: Identity is now queryable without forcing file movement or false deduplication.
return_receipt.residue: Raw-byte inaccessible Project-backed Library files remain outside this object.
return_receipt.next: Produce one actual physical/print RETURN from the related print-proof branch before promoting any filesystem mutation.
